about.text: Dinarski sir iz maslinove komine is a hard cheese originating from the Dalmatian hinterlands around Dinara mountain. It is made from a combination of cow’s and goat’s milk. The cheese is aged for at least 4 months in pressed olive skins.

sources.text: Gligora's webshop gives 4 months+; Dinarski sir ripened in pressed olive pomace (rind from pomace). A flavour variant of Dinarski sir; max is an upper guess
